project.name: BeetleOps HRMS
project.description: Enterprise Human Resource Management System featuring touchless Slack presence synchronization, dynamic hierarchical leave approvals, company holiday targeting, payroll deductions, and headless Chrome salary slips.

applications.name: Super Admin Portal
applications.description: Executive administration of users, organization tree, leave types, holidays, session overrides, payroll estimation, and salary slips.

applications.name: Staff Portal
applications.description: Self-service employee portal for leave applications and personal track record, plus line-manager team supervision and approval queue.

applications.name: Slack Webhook Endpoint
applications.description: Public callback endpoint accepting HMAC-signed Slack Events API messages for real-time presence logging.

applications.name: Documentation Site
applications.description: Public interactive markdown documentation web app located in the 'doc website' directory.

authorization.model: Role-Based Access Control + Dynamic Hierarchical Authority
authorization.managerHierarchy: Dynamic BFS upward recursion via manager_id

externalIntegrations.name: Puppeteer / Headless Chrome
externalIntegrations.type: Local CLI Binary Process via spatie/browsershot
externalIntegrations.purpose: A4 PDF Salary Slip rendering from HTML Blade

externalIntegrations.name: PhpOffice/PhpSpreadsheet
externalIntegrations.purpose: Excel export for Track Records and Salary Estimation sheets

externalIntegrations.name: SMTP Mail Server
externalIntegrations.purpose: Salary slip PDF delivery and password resets

testing.status: No automated test suite present in active repository

knownRisks: Complete absence of automated test suite creates critical regression hazard.
Monstrous controller files (SessionManagementController 4,181 lines, SlackWebhookController 2,010 lines).
Core system settings stored as flat unversioned JSON files in storage/app/.
Synchronous Headless Chrome PDF generation inside web worker HTTP requests.
Hardcoded 'Asia/Karachi' timezone across 40+ controllers and queries.
Direct filesystem coupling for letterhead image uploads in public/images/.

suspectedBugs.issue: Multi-day range permitted on half-day leave types without asserting start_date == end_date.
Checks direct reports only (1 level) rather than using recursive BFS subordinate_ids.
Synthetic virtual signout sets timestamp to checkin + 1 minute, collapsing recorded work duration to 1 minute.
Static 16-hour lookback threshold treats legitimate long shifts as stale sessions.

openQuestions: How is the background queue worker managed and monitored in production?
Is production deployed on a single virtual machine or across autoscaled containers?
Does company HR policy permit multi-day half-day leave applications?
Is Slack presence tracking restricted to a dedicated channel, or does the bot listen across multiple channels?
